node.title: Re^2: Why a regex *really* isn't good enough for HTML, even for "simple" tasks
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Thank you, I've added this one to [https://gist.github.com/haukex/fd76efa16f0b07ce6a7441d9b2265b2a#file-sol-mechanize-pl|the Gist] too! (and in the meantime I added a [mod://XML::LibXML] solution for the XHTML as well)

Since HTML::TokeParser and HTML::Parser even live in the same distribution, I'll look at a pull request to change the parser type to the one that works.

It looks to me like [mod://HTML::TokeParser] isa [mod://HTML::Parser], so I think it's probably possible to set the options required to parse the XHTML (marked_sections and xml_mode) - but it looks like [mod://WWW::Mechanize] doesn't provide any way to set custom options on the parser.
